messages.subject: Rendering multidimension contingency table
parts:
I am looking at advice and suggestion on how I can get to render multi dimension contingency table using Shiny in R.
I have tried using tableoutput and rendertable to render flat contingency tables generated using ftable. However I was able to get it to render it properly only when I had single dimension on each axis (x and y). As soon as the number of dimensions on either axis increased, the rendering fell off. (for below example the labels started appearing as 0_3, 0_4, etc..  on y axis and four_0, four_1, etc.. on x-axis which did not look good)
I am looking for rendering something like below in UI.
